svg.title: Exact cold active-support source simulation
svg.desc: Baseline insertion attempts split by inactive-variable mask. Keeping only the empty-mask sequence gives the identical active-only certificate. At matched first success B equals C plus K, and candidate attempts C are bounded by successful baseline attempts B and the common row cap. Symbolic diagram, no measurement.

g.text: One-loop change • exact certificate • conditional cap bound
Cold FIFO; original labels/order; exact pivot masks; support from all cleaned generators
Same tag in row and every multiplier component
Identical useful rows, pivots and certificates
Nonempty tags cannot change this FIFO or yield 1
B = C + K; K ≥ 0; C ≤ B ≤ row_cap
At matched first success: B/C = attempted insertions; K = removed calls. No empirical samples.
No inferred runtime, full-search or degree improvement
Inactive bits stay free; UNKNOWN and warm starts stay outside the implication
